subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 1: School things – I've got … + Sound i
outcomes: I can say bag, pen, eraser and ruler.
I can say It's a … and I've got a/an …
I can say the sound /ɪ/ and read sit, pin and tin.

tf.why: Yes! Eraser starts with e, so we say an.

tf.s: We use a ruler to draw straight lines.
tf.why: Yes! A ruler helps us draw lines.

tf.s: Igloo starts with the letter a.
In the story, Meg has got Fatma's bag.
tf.why: Yes! Meg the cat has got the bag.

tf.s: A bag is a family word.
tf.why: A bag is a school thing.

boxes.q: We put our books in a …
boxes.why: Books go in a school bag.

boxes.q: Fatma: I'm ready for school. I've got a …
boxes.why: A pen is a school thing.

hunt.q: Catch the school thing for writing.
Catch the school thing for lines.
Catch the school thing that cleans mistakes.
Catch the school thing for books.
Catch the right one: I've got …

mcq.q: Which one is a school thing?
mcq.why: A ruler is a school thing.

mcq.q: Which of these words starts with /ɪ/?
Who has got Fatma's school bag?
mcq.why: Meg the cat has got it.

mcq.q: Your teacher holds up an eraser: What is it? You say …
You have a pen and a ruler. You say …
o: I've got a pen and a ruler.
mcq.why: I've got … tells what you have.

mcq.q: Teacher: Show me a ruler. What do you hold up?
Why do we say an eraser but a pen?
mcq.why: We use an before sounds like e, a, i.

mcq.q: Which word does not belong: bag, pen, ruler, sister?
Sit, pin, tin. What sound is in the middle?
mcq.why: They all have i in the middle.
